name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – After § 52 – Am 18
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 52a. Recalls that the only common denominator for Europe is its Christian heritage, and that this heritage led to individual freedom, democratic institutions and the traditional rule of law; notes with concern, therefore, that, according to the Open Doors organisation, more than 380 million Christians worldwide suffer high levels of persecution for their faith; is deeply concerned about the continued violence against Christians across sub-Saharan Africa and in the Middle East;
